behavior.default: no parity clone or comparison unless VLLM_XPU_MOE_ONEDNN_SIDECAR_EXECUTE selects gemm1 or gemm2
behavior.execute_mode_1: clone gemm1_output before sidecar execution, then log before checksum, after checksum, and max_abs_diff_f32 after execution
behavior.execute_mode_2: clone gemm2_output before sidecar execution, then log before checksum, after checksum, and max_abs_diff_f32 after execution
behavior.synchronization: diagnostic path synchronizes after oneDNN execution before reading checksums/diff; sidecar max-call/layer/rank gates keep this out of normal performance paths
